metadata.description: Pharma commercial operations plugins — Agent Skills + MCP servers

plugins.name: open-pharma-plugins-hcp-intelligence
plugins.description: HCP/HCO intelligence: build structured, evidence-backed profiles from PubMed, ClinicalTrials.gov, ORCID, NIH RePORTER, and web sources.

plugins.name: open-pharma-plugins-field-training
plugins.description: Turn approved PDF/PPTX paths into source-grounded learning packages, assessments, pre-session role-play kits, and post-session scorecards.

plugins.name: open-pharma-plugins-campaign-studio
plugins.description: Campaign studio: end-to-end pharma campaign creation with brief, message architecture, channel copy, and asset rendering.

plugins.name: open-pharma-plugins-next-best-engagement
plugins.description: Next-best-engagement planning: score HCPs, select actions via rule cascade, and allocate to reps with greedy optimisation.

plugins.name: open-pharma-plugins-territory-alignment
plugins.description: Territory alignment: assign HCPs to reps balancing workload, travel, disruption and coverage; plan visit routes and clusters; visualise on interactive maps.

plugins.name: open-pharma-plugins-competitive-intelligence
plugins.description: Competitive intelligence: track competitor trial pipelines, FDA regulatory events, label changes, news, and publications with shareable briefing reports.
